Dana, I couldn't find the amendment itself. The accounts folder isn't in what I can read from your side of the share, so I can't open it.

The closest record I found is in #north-team from 20 Aug 2025. You posted that Quarrendon Freight Lines was going to 180 seats under Amendment No. 1, then corrected it a minute later to **185 seats**. That's from a chat, not the signed amendment, so check it against the signed copy before the QBR. The March 2026 renewal note doesn't give a seat count, so if the renewal changed the number, the amendment won't show it.
